description: Build a minimal valid ApexGantt options object. Generates a placeholder schedule (phases, dependencies, a milestone) when `tasks` is omitted, so the result can be rendered as-is. The placeholder dates are emitted in whatever `inputDateFormat` is chosen, so they parse without further work.

baseline.description: Enable planned-vs-actual baseline track. Tasks must supply a per-task `baseline: { start, end }`.

enableCriticalPath.description: Highlight the longest dependency chain on render.

height.description: Chart height in px, emitted as the top-level `height` option (default 600 here; the library default is 500px).

inputDateFormat.description: dayjs format for parsing date strings. Default is ApexGantt's own default "MM-DD-YYYY". Common alternatives: "YYYY-MM-DD", "DD/MM/YYYY".

tasks.description: Task array (`series`). Each task: { id, name, startTime, endTime?, progress?, type?, parentId?, dependency? }. Give single-date markers `type: "milestone"` (3.19 and earlier throw on a missing endTime otherwise).

name: apexgantt_generate_config
title: Generate ApexGantt config
